vo: Every supplier wants your purchase orders a different way. A PDF, a CSV, an Excel sheet, cXML, even EDI. Instead of reformatting each one by hand, you drop the order into ProcuLink, and it detects the format automatically.
It parses every line, and surfaces only the ones that actually need your attention. Not the whole order.
When a supplier uses different item codes, the AI suggests the mapping, with a confidence score and the reason behind it, and it remembers your corrections for next time.
Before anything goes out, the order is checked against that supplier's own acceptance rules, so it isn't rejected at the other end.
Then ProcuLink transforms the order into the exact format that supplier requires, and delivers it. Over HTTP, SFTP, email, or straight into their ERP.
Every step is logged. A complete audit trail, and proof of delivery for every order. Boringly reliable, by design. Try ProcuLink free with a sample order today.
